name: The Spymaster's Ledger
about: The old spymaster dies and his ledger of every lord's secrets goes missing. Whoever holds it can bend the great houses. Find it first, burn it, or use it, and live with what the lords learn you know.
title: The Spymaster's Ledger

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The crown's old spymaster dies in his sleep, and his ledger, every secret of every great house, is gone from his locked chest.

court.text: {named} of {named.house}, too careful: "They say the old man kept a book, Your Grace. I trust the crown has it safe?"

options.label: Turn the court inside out to find it (200 gold)
options.hint: the hunt begins · every lord nervous
options.result: The King's men search every chamber and saddlebag in Kingsmere. The great lords leave early.

options.label: Tell {named} the crown has it, and smile
options.result: The King says the ledger is safe. {named} goes very pale, and very polite.

options.label: There is no ledger: an old man's boast
options.hint: nothing now · whoever has it is free to use it
options.result: The King laughs off the ledger. Somewhere, someone turns a page.

beats.speaker: thief
beats.text: Lords begin to vote, marry and buy as {thief} wishes. {named} sells {thief} a town for a song, and will not say why.

court.text: {named}, alone and low: "{thief} has the ledger, Your Grace. {thief.He} has my secrets, and half the realm's. Take it from {thief.him}, and I am yours."

options.label: Send the King's men to search {hall}
options.hint: {thief.houseName} −30 · if it isn't there, you look a tyrant
options.result: The King's men tear {hall} apart by torchlight.

options.label: Buy the ledger from {thief} (500 gold)
options.hint: {thief.houseName} +10 · the crown holds the realm's secrets
options.result: The ledger changes hands in a church at midnight. {thief} keeps the copy, of course.

options.label: Let {thief} overreach
options.hint: nothing now · the lords bend to {thief}
options.result: The King waits. {thief}'s friends at court grow in number every week.

beats.speaker: thief
beats.text: With half the realm's secrets in {thief.his} hand, {thief} calls the great lords to {hall}, and they come. {thief} asks why a King who knew nothing of them should rule them.

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The crown holds the old spymaster's ledger now. Every great lord knows it, and every great lord is suddenly very loyal, and very afraid.

court.text: {named}: "The ledger is yours, Your Grace. Will you use it, or burn it?"

options.label: Burn it before the court
options.hint: every house warms · the crown gives up a weapon
options.result: The ledger burns in the great hall's hearth. The lords breathe again, and some of them cheer.

options.label: Keep it, and let them wonder
options.hint: quiet obedience · a grudge in every house
options.result: The ledger goes into the King's own chest. The court has never been so courteous.

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The ledger's pages are ash or in the crown's keeping, and its secrets with them. The great houses go back to plotting the old way: in the open.
